messages:
anya: Quick sync — want to lock the onboarding eval matrix and pin policy before next week's partner demo. TL;DR: can we commit to clear pass/fail for new models, and a default pin window?
raj: +1. Do we have a recommended metric set or should we keep it lightweight for launch?
deven: For launch I'd keep it to latency P95, cost per 1k tokens, and a quality proxy (BLEU/ROUGE for seq tasks, or ppl for LM). Simpler for customers to understand.
lina: For chat/assistant models ppl isn't great. Suggest we use LLM evals: helpfulness score (0-5) on our internal eval suite + hallucination rate.
anya: Good point. Proposal: latency P95 <= 250ms for hosted small models, <= 400ms for larger; cost delta vs baseline model <= 1.5x; eval helpfulness >= 4.0 and hallucination <= 2%. These are launch thresholds, not hard SLOs. Thoughts?
cara: That seems reasonable. For enterprise tiers we may relax latency but require stronger pin guarantees. Also need migration notice policy for customers pinned to older versions.
raj: About pinning: default behavior for onboarding should be "unpinned" unless customer explicitly requests pin. For customer-requested pins, require documented SLAs (pin length, upgrade window).
deven: Ops note: automatic fallback chain if a pinned model becomes unavailable — do we allow automatic failure to next-compatible model? We should require explicit permission from customer for automatic fallback.
lina: Agreed. So two flows: 1) unpinned: platform can route to compatible variant; 2) pinned: no automatic fallback unless customer opt-in. Add migration advisory emails and canary rollout.
anya: Migration cadence: owners must publish a migration playbook + impact matrix. Recommend minimum 30 days notice for deprecation and a 90-day supported window before forced migration for enterprise customers (shorter for hosted free-tier).
cara: We should also add an opt-in beta for customers to test new model weights (canary group). Product: can we surface a "pin status" and migration ETA in Console?
anya: Yes — UX asks: show pin flag, pin expiry, migration ETA, and a link to playbook. Lina/DevEx can draft the UI copy.
lina: Will do. Also adding eval-run IDs to the model page so customers can reproduce benchmarks.
deven: infra note: to support eval reproducibility we need to store seed/config + dataset version. I'll open infra ticket. deploy-bot: New ticket created: INFRA-3942 — store eval metadata for model pages.
anya: Action items: 
- Deven: infra ticket (INFRA-3942) — due EOD Thu
- Lina: UX copy + eval-run UI mock — due Mon
- Raj: draft pin policy doc + customer migration template — due Mon
- Cara: list enterprise SLA exceptions and expected pin windows — due Mon
We'll review in product sync Tue. If no objections today, I'll treat these as the plan for launch. :thumbsup:
raj: No objections from me. +1
cara: sounds good to me
lina: fine with this
deven: ok
anya: Thanks team — closing thread and will add to roadmap ticket.
deploy-bot: Roadmap ticket updated: PROD-7421 — "Onboarding eval matrix & pin policy" (linked to INFRA-3942).
